lines.text: My cake fell flat. Total epic fail!

data.define: A mistake or failure that is so big it is almost funny.

example.text: My cake fell flat. Total epic fail!

misuse.text: Don't call a friend's loss an 'epic fail'.

data.l1_hook: Meu bolo desabou. Todos assistiram! "epic fail"
data.l1_ex: Meu bolo solou. Um verdadeiro "epic fail"!
